replication.target_description: Many Labs 4, location 17, IH protocol, Exclusion Set 1; independent-samples t-test of mortality salience versus TV control on pro-minus-anti-US essay-author ratings.

n.sample_role: Analytic participants in the independent-samples site-level mortality-salience versus TV-control test; sum of mutually exclusive final randomized conditions.
n.exclusions: Exclusion Set 1. Project-level exclusion of labs with fewer than 60 total recruits and data collected before preregistration; participant exclusion for incomplete six author ratings, and incomplete writing prompts at AA sites only because the necessary data were not always available for IH sites. Table 3 gives final condition counts. Sets 2 and 3 are not used for this target.
